name: Automobiles
overview: Scripture reminds believers to place their trust in God's strength and providence rather than in earthly possessions or means of transportation. While Nahum describes chariots rushing like lightning, symbolizing speed and power, Isaiah and Jeremiah assure us that God upholds and guides us with peace and purpose. Believers are cautioned against hoarding material treasures, including those related to their journeys, and are instead called to seek first God's kingdom, trusting that He will provide all their needs.
